goal: Build an evidence-backed learning forest for creating accessible public information dashboards

corrections.statement: Render every domain from top to bottom
corrections.regressionCheck: Every published forest declares layoutDirection as top-to-bottom

corrections.statement: Split the forest into explicit domains instead of attaching everything to one root
corrections.regressionCheck: Every node belongs to one domain and the renderer exposes domain navigation
The audit rejects chapter, unit, page, or partial-resource assignments

corrections.statement: Split compound topics into independently learnable nodes
corrections.regressionCheck: Compound node titles enter the review queue

corrections.statement: Explain three current research frontiers for every node
corrections.regressionCheck: The audit rejects nodes without exactly three traceable frontier positions

corrections.statement: Judge releases through realistic user journeys
corrections.regressionCheck: Every release carries a user-journey review with observed friction and changes
